answers.value: LHS = \(\frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A\) = RHS (proved)
answers.scheme: LHS \(= \frac{(\frac{\cos A}{\sin A} + \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} - 1)(\sin A + \cos A)}{\sin^3 A + \cos^3 A} = \frac{(\cos^2 A + \sin^2 A - \sin A \cos A)(\sin A + \cos A)}{(\sin^3 A + \cos^3 A)\sin A \cos A} = \frac{\sin^3 A + \cos^3 A}{(\sin^3 A + \cos^3 A)\sin A \cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A\) = RHS (using \(\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1\) and \(a^3 + b^3 = (a+b)(a^2 - ab + b^2)\)).

Sum of TSA = TSA of cylinder + TSA of 2 hemispheres \(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 14 + 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5^2 + 2\{2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5^2\}\) (\(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) or 3.14) \(= 22 \times 14 + 8 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 = 308 + 308 = 616\) cm\(^2\).
